column3: if · A Certain Mystery in Kyoto Chapter
What are you saying we'll find by exploring?
It might be that we find something, or nothing at all.
You keep stating the incredibly obvious.
Shut up. We have nothing to do right now, so why not?
Well, I can't argue against that. Whatever, I'll tag along.
Alright! Let's explore the inn then!
What are we two guys doing together...?
Now then, let's start from this corridor!
Well, it's standard to start off from a corner.
That's right! It's already a well-established fact that corridor corners of buildings hold nasty secrets!
...Oh really?
Come on, let's go!
Alright, alright...
It was supposed to be a short walk in the inn for a bit with Akagi, but...
The inn exploration ended rather quickly.
The building wasn't very large itself, and neither did it have any particularly strange places.
Of course, this was pretty much expected.
There won't be any weird stuff in such a normal inn... Right?
And as expected-
There's nothing...
The one who suggested to explore this place was you, wasn't it?
Well, that's true, but it's Kyoto isn't it? I expected to find something here...
It's precisely because it's Kyoto, that's why river spirits would have trouble spawning here!
Well, that was killing time. Although it was really unproductive.
No, not yet!
You're still planning something...?
We haven't gone through everything, have we?
Does that matter?
Yeah! We haven't opened that door yet, have we?
Door?
I looked in the direction of said door, to which Akagi was pointing at.
True, it was there - the door we hadn't opened yet.
...But was that door even there before?
We haven't looked in there, have we?
It's an unusually old door.
Yeah. Plain strange.
Yeah...
The door gave off a feeling of antiquity I had never ever experienced with anything else before.
The doorknob was super old and rusty, and the door itself seems to have become almost black from how dirty it was.
Strange... Very strange...!
...Are we really opening it?
Huh? What are you saying, of course we are.
Have you even spared a thought as to what might happen if we open it?
Nothing will happen. It's just a door.
Oh right. You were always that stupid, huh.
Whatever, let's just open the door.
Yeah.
Nothing in this room...
Rather, it's just a room without lights on, and it's nothing different from a normal room.
Nothing here, eh?
Yeah.
...Wait, what's with you? Talk properly.
You too, you sound like the 8-bit games of yesteryear.
Huh?! But I'm speaking properly, you-
...Eh? Hold on... Something seems... off.
I can understand what Akagi says, but I hear him going "Pupupu"...
And when I looked at Akagi...
Y-You, you somehow turned into a bunch of pixels, all of a sudden!
Hahaha. That's a strange coincidence. I see you in the same way too.
Why are you so calm about this?!
Ahah. I see... I get it now.
W-What is it?
Perchance, this is the judgment wrought upon our souls for daring disturb an ancient power in Kyoto.
HUH?!
Don't you get it? Basically, this mystery will be solved once we get the treasure inside.
...What kind of delusion is this?!?!
Anyway, we can't start if you don't move. Let's search this room!
H-Hey!
And so, prompted by Akagi again, I started to search the entire room again, but...
Isn't this just a normal room...?
Yeah. That's right. What is this, some trickery!?
This has all been your wild interpretation!
Let's go to the next room. I'm closing this room's door.
Yeah.
What now?
Something dropped.
Eh ?
Akagi was about to close the door, but his hands stopped as he stared at something in the room.
What's that?
Who knows. I'll go take a look.
Akagi went into the room and picked up that little something that dropped.
Looks like it's...
A pamphlet...? It's written "Fushimi Inari Shrine" on there.
Fushimi Inari Shrine, huh...
Hold on a second, this isn't exactly Fushimi Inari, is it?!
Then what is it?
It's the Underground Fushimi Inari...!
Underground Fushimi Inari?!
Yeah, this is getting interesting, isn't it?
Sounds suspicious to me.
Well, don't put it that way. Uh... the legendary Underground Fushimi Inari Shrine that can grant any wish...
This whole affair is becoming more and more suspicious...
Hold on. There's more. The Underground Fushimi Inari Shrine is sleeping underneath Kyoto.
Isn't that even more suspicious!? Also, where did all the talk about the treasure go?
The legendary Underground Fushimi Inari Shrine that can grant any wish...!
Hey, Akagi... Are you listening?
That's incredible! Any wish can be granted!
Get a grip on yourself man! Be realistic! It's too good to be true!
What are you saying? Any wish can be granted, you know!
NO! STOP!
What is this Underground Fushimi Inari?! It's way too suspicious!
It's called Fushimi Inari because it's in the Fushimi area! And we're in Sanjyou, Higashiyama right now!
Don't believe everything that you read!
Okay, I've decided!
I'm having a reaaaaally bad feeling about this...
I'm going to this Underground Fushimi Inari!
I knew it...
Of course. You're coming too, right?
Why would I? It's suspicious, no matter how I look at it.
What are you saying!? It's for the thrill!
I don't need that kind of thrill in my life!
Any wish can be granted, you know.
Doesn't it sound too good to be true?
You idiot! You gotta dream!!
How can I have a dream with such a pamphlet that you simply picked up!!
But your wishes can be granted!
I bet your wish is about your relationship with your sister anyway.
Can there be anything else?
Don't answer with such a straight face...
Okay, I've decided. Let's do it and change Japan's laws.
Hey, I haven't said that I'll go...
Hey, Kousaka, look there.
Eh?
The corner of the room. The trapdoor on the floor.
How can there be a... wait, there it is.
Indeed, there's a door on the floor in the corner of the room.
I hate this kind of blatant deus-ex-machina.
It feels like I'm in a game or anime again...
No, this scene would probably be too cheesy for even an 8-bit game.
The Underground Fushimi Inari, which rests beneath Kyoto...
No matter how you look at it, it seems far too convenient.
We'll think about that if nothing does happen.
Hey, Akagi.
Okay, I'll try opening it.
Can you be a little more cautious?!
It's fine, just help me!
Argh really...!
The door on the floor opened with the same sound as before.
It's stairs...
Yeah, stairs...
There were a continuing flight of stairs below the opened door.
This is... This is way too convenient!
This is nothing but suspicious!!!
...but I'm the only one who thought this way.
Whoa, Kousaka, it's awesome! It's really here! The Underground Fushimi Inari Shrine!
This is way too convenient.
Okay, let's go take a look!
You're not listening at all... Hey! Are you seriously going!? Akagi!!
Akagi started going down the stairs without listening to a word that I've said.
I can't just let him go alone...
Argh, damn! I don't have any other choice!
Wait up, Akagi! It's dangerous to go alone!
After going down the stairs, there was an area with a very high ceiling.
Akagi walked ahead, while I hurriedly chased after him.
Akagi!
Oh, you came along after all.
You idiot. It's because you went all by yourself.
There you go again. Although you say that, but you're actually curious about the Underground Fushimi Inari.
Who cares about that...
Well, since you're here, let's look for it together!
Yeah, yeah.
We steadily forged ahead.
Before we noticed, we had walked quite a distance, but have not found anything of interest.
Was it really a good idea to continue forward...?
I glanced back, but the stairs from earlier were not longer visible.
What trailed behind us was nothing but darkness.
We've probably come a pretty long way already.
Hey, is it really okay to continue walking so far?
I wouldn't know about that.
That's true, but..
Oh?
What is it.
It's a Shinto shrine gate?
Why is there a shrine gate underground...!?
This is it, isn't it.
It's the shrine gate of Fushimi Inari.
It can't be...
Awesome! So it actually exists?!
Lo-Looks like it.
With this scene in front of me, I can no longer deny the existence of Underground Fushimi Inari.
Akagi is all fired up, and I am getting a little excited as well...
Alright! In we go!
Yeah!
The meandering road of gates continued on forever.
I no longer had any sense of direction; nor did I have any idea where I was.
Oh? I see something.
It's true... It looks like something from a shrine.
It does seem like a small shrine.
Oh-! Awesome! I'm so glad we came here.
But this is the thing that can grant wishes? It looks shabby.
Don't say such things! Our wishes can be granted.
But...
A small shrine stood beyond the gates.
But... it looks a little dirty and useless.
But Akagi looked really confident that our wishes can be granted.
Now! Let's get to fulfilling my wishes!
*sigh*... Do whatever you want. We're heading back when you're done.
I got it.
Akagi stood in front of the small shrine. With a serious look on his face, he placed his hands together and bowed his head.
May my sister and I be close together for life--!
Wha?!
Whoa! It's too bright...!!!
Wha-!? Wh-Wh-What on earth!?
I could feel the light pierce through my eyelids and into my eyes!
What in the world is happening?!
...H-Hey, Kousaka...
...U-Urgh, Akagi...?
Hm? No more "pupupupu"'s?
What is this... We were at the suspicious underground place up till this moment...
But this is... a familiar scenery...
...We were on the school trip, right?
Y-Yeah.
Why are we... standing in front of the school?
Don't ask me...
For some reason, when we came to, Akagi and I were standing in front of the school.
But we were indeed in front of the small shrine of the Underground Fushimi Inari a short while ago.
What the heck happened to us...?
Onii-chan～!
Wha?!
Onii-chan～!
Onii-chan? Hey, is that kid perhaps your little sister?
She's quite cute. But she definitely loses out to my sister!
Indeed, the out-of-breath person running over is Kirino.
But... Why would she call me "Onii-chan"?
My body filled with a strange uncomfortable feeling.
Onii-chan, what's wrong? Weren't you on your school trip?
K-Kirino...?
Yep, it's me. So, what about it?
The Kirino that appeared in front of me called me "Onii-chan," and on top of that, a big and glittering smile floated on her face.
W-What's wrong with you...?
What do you mean?
W-Well, uh...
Could it be... that you felt lonely because you couldn't get to see me, so you came back earlier before the rest?
Th-That's impossib-
If that's the case, I'm happy. I feel lonely when Onii-chan's not here too!
What? What kind of trap is this!? Actually, who is this I'm talking to!?
Kirino is more like, bang, wham, gyah! Something like that!
...It's the effect of the Underground Fushimi Inari.
What?
Our wish went through to Underground Fushimi Inari! This means, my sister too!?
By your logic, what you're saying is that your wish also affected me, and this changed Kirino's personality?
Her personality is a complete 180! It's completely different!?
The heck is this!? In the first place, I didn't wish for anything!!
Hey, Akagi...
Oooohhh!! Where's my sister-!!
Hey～?
Without listening to a word I said, Akagi dashed off.
Did Akagi's sister really become like this too?
I can't even imagine...
Kirino? Something wrong?
Onii-chan, were you with that guy on the entire trip?
That guy... You're referring to Akagi? Well, that's right.
Why?
Why... because we're friends... pretty much.
No way. Don't do that sort of thing again.
Huh?
It would be all right if Onii-chan is only with me.
What's with you?
Onii-chan just needs to only be with me!
Hey, Kirino...
And, that person! That girl!!
Who's that girl?
That person! Plain Girl!!!
Plain girl... What about Manami?
Don't say her name! Don't let anything about her touch your lips!
H-Hey...
Please look only at me, call only my name.
You say that, but she's a childhood friend.
I don't care! I'm your little sister! I'm closer to you! I'm closer to you than that person will ever be!
The moment I mentioned Manami's name, Kirino's expression changed completely.
It's like she's jealous beyond measure... Wait, jealous?
Why is she jealous of Manami?
That's right... not just Plain Girl. Kuroneko, and Saori, and Ayase...
Kirino?
Each and every one of them are gunning for Onii-chan. Why didn't I realize until now?
Wh-What are you talking about...
No problem. I won't let anyone lay a finger on you, and I'm the only one allowed to do that.
Hey, Kirino...
I won't let you get close to those female cats.
How can you say that about your friends?!
I don't need friends who are aiming for Onii-chan!
Kirino! Calm down!
I'm very calm! I just love Onii-chan a lot.
H-Hold on a moment, hey...
What the heck is she talking about?!
She loves me? That's strange!
I don't need this plot development in my life!
Honestly, what's with you?
Onii-chan is really kind. But this kindness will mislead others, so it's better for you to stop.
No, I'm not trying to mislead anyone.
Subconsciously affecting them, huh...
Hey, are you even listening?
If it's done subconsciously, then it can't be helped...
Kirino. Heyyyyy.
I see. If Onii-chan can't go out alone, then it will all be fine.
It's okay, Onii-chan. I will al～ways be by your side.
No, no. It's fine. It's fine just by myself.
That won't do!
Hiee!!!
I have a hunch that I should escape or else...
When I was just about to move my body, Kirino grabbed my arm.
It's all right...
K-Kirino, let go.
Why?
My arm, it hurts...
I'm only holding onto it lightly.
Without dropping her smile, Kirino held my arm strongly with her hands.
At this moment, I heard a grinding noise.
What kind of strength is this...!
Ou-Ouch! It really hurts!
It's just for a short while.
H-Hey! Kirino!
Arms, legs... and later, fingers too...
Kirino! Kirino!!
It's all right, Onii-chan. This is for the sake of us being together forever.
What Akagi wished for at the shrine just now came to mind.
May my sister and I be close together for life
No... This isn't what it meant!
Definitely not!
Let's get along from now on.
As I look at Kirino saying that with a sweet smile, my body chilled to the bone.
If I don't escape, something unthinkable will happen.
It's the only thing I could make of the whole situation.
My Onii-chan～ Just for me～
Kirino said that with a smile and an adorable voice.
In an instant, my arm was forcibly bent in the opposite direction.
Onii-chan, we'll be together forever!
